title: Exact SL(2,Z)-Structure of Lattice Maxwell Theory with $θ$-term in Modified Villain Formulation
summary: We study the duality of lattice Maxwell theory in the modified Villain formulation, employing an ultra-local action with a theta term. Although this action is known to become non ultra-local through the Poisson resummation formula, we show that this non ultra-locality can be removed by incorporating a non-local transformation procedure into the definition of the S-transformation. As a result, the ultra-local action with a theta term exhibits an exact SL(2,Z)-duality.
